name: evaluate-sessions
description: Auto-evaluate completed sessions every 4 hours (JS handler)

name: system-status
description: Operational status check every 4 hours (JS handler)

name: analyze-failures
message: [cron:analyze-failures] Analyze the last 10 evaluations in .state/evaluations/. Identify the top recurring pattern. Write findings to agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md. Compare recent evaluations against previous ones — did targeted fixes help? If same issue persists, recommend a different approach.
description: Bob analyzes evaluation patterns daily (dedicated instance)

name: optimize
message: [cron:optimize] Read agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md and agents/optimizer/workspace/todo.md. Work on the top TODO item or top finding. Check for LLM-to-JS replacement opportunities. One fix per run.
description: Optimizer implements one fix per day (dedicated instance)

name: health-check
message: [cron:health-check] Run: npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest --run. Report pass/fail and test count. If anything fails, investigate.
description: Daily tsc + test suite health check (dedicated instance)

name: coaching
message: [cron:coaching] Read agents/coach/workspace/todo.md. If there are pending items under # TODO (not # Tracking), work on the top item. You have subagents and can run exercises on other agents. One task per run. If TODO is empty, skip silently.

name: lesson-consolidation
message: [cron:lesson-consolidation] Read all agents/*/knowledge/lessons.md files. Deduplicate, consolidate, remove stale entries. Preserve proven lessons.

name: philosophy-check
message: [cron:philosophy-check] Check recent git commits (git log --since='24 hours ago' --oneline) for philosophy violations. Read agents/shared/philosophy.md, review changes. Write findings to agents/bob/workspace/philosophy-check.md.
description: Daily philosophy alignment check (dedicated instance, disabled)

name: heartbeat-bob
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Bob's mission heartbeat — design reflection, philosophy audit (24h)

name: heartbeat-optimizer
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Optimizer's mission heartbeat — find highest-impact improvement (24h)

name: heartbeat-coach
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Coach's mission heartbeat — plan training, review progress (48h)

name: heartbeat-evaluator
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Evaluator's mission heartbeat — review eval quality, calibrate (24h)

name: heartbeat-amy
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Amy's mission heartbeat — XHS exploration and insight synthesis (12h)

name: heartbeat-scout
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Scout's mission heartbeat — wide-net research and discovery (24h)
